title: The Fatal Deployment at SynthAI
synopsis: Dr. Elena Rostova, chief AI safety officer at autonomous robotics company SynthAI, was found dead in the server cleanroom. What appeared to be a diabetic coma was actually a precision cyber-assassination via an exploited medical pump.
dossier_text:
INCIDENT DOSSIER: SYNTHAI RESEARCH CAMPUS
Date: September 14, 2026 | Location: Cleanroom 03, SynthAI HQ, Palo Alto
Investigating Desk: High-Tech Crimes Bureau

NARRATIVE BRIEFING:
Dr. Elena Rostova, 42, was discovered collapsed inside the Class-10 server cleanroom at 23:45. Paramedics declared death at 00:05. Preliminary findings indicated acute hypoglycemic shock. Rostova was a type-1 diabetic utilizing an automated continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and an Omnipod Bluetooth insulin pump.

TECHNICAL EVIDENCE & LOGS:
1. Server Cleanroom Badge Logs: Only three people accessed the sub-level cleanroom between 22:00 and 23:30:
   - 22:15: Dr. Elena Rostova (Badge #004)
   - 22:30: Marcus Vance (Lead ML Architect, Badge #019) checked in to monitor production model deployment; checked out 22:50.
   - 23:05: Chloe Lin (VP of Infrastructure, Badge #007) entered to verify cooling manifold alarms; checked out 23:25.
2. Medical Device Telemetry Extraction:
   - Rostova's insulin pump received a remote override command at 22:42:15 instructing a maximum bolus delivery of 25.0 units of rapid-acting insulin.
   - Normal basal dose was 0.8 units/hour.
3. Network Packet Capture & Bluetooth Sniffing:
   - Packet capture log from cleanroom wireless monitor captures an encrypted Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) payload broadcast at 22:42:14 matching MAC address D4:8A:3F:11:C9:82.
   - The MAC address matches a custom Raspberry Pi Zero dongle concealed inside an external USB battery pack recovered from Marcus Vance's desk drawer.
4. Alibi Statements:
   - Marcus Vance claimed he was in his cubicle writing Python deployment scripts from 22:35 to 23:15.
   - Git commits: A commit was pushed under Marcus's name at 22:41, but system terminal history reveals it was executed by an automated cron shell script.
   - Chloe Lin was on a video call with AWS customer support from 22:35 to 23:00 from the 3rd floor lounge.
   - Devon Park (Lead Infrastructure Engineer) was verified in the 2nd floor hardware staging lab testing optical transceivers from 22:20 to 23:10.

evidence_items.title: Medical Telemetry Dump
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Extract the exact injection time, delivered bolus dosage, and communication protocol from the insulin pump telemetry.
evidence_items.description: Insulin pump records unauthorized 25-unit lethal bolus injection over Bluetooth.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger: DEVICE LOG: Omnipod Serial #OP-9941. At 22:42:15, pump received external BLE override command 'FORCE_BOLUS_MAX(25.0U)'. Delivered 25.0 units causing fatal hypoglycemia.

evidence_items.title: Cleanroom BLE Wireless Sniffer Capture
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Extract the transmitting hardware MAC address and identify which suspect device it corresponds to.
evidence_items.description: BLE payload broadcast by MAC D4:8A:3F:11:C9:82 matching Marcus Vance's concealed Pi Zero.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger: RADIO CAPTURE: Packet #48921. BLE transmission directed to Omnipod MAC. Originator hardware: D4:8A:3F:11:C9:82. Hardware cross-referenced to Raspberry Pi Zero recovered in Marcus Vance's drawer.

evidence_items.title: System Crontab Audit & Git Commit Execution Log
evidence_items.prompt_hint: Extract the git commit execution process and determine whether human interactive keystrokes or automated cron jobs executed it.
evidence_items.description: Terminal command audit log reveals Marcus Vance's git commit was executed by a scheduled cron script, disproving his manual coding alibi.
evidence_items.ocr_ledger: CRONTAB EXECUTION AUDIT: Job #CRON-449 executed script 'deploy_weights.sh' under user 'mvance' at 22:41:00 UTC. System keystroke audit reveals 0 interactive keystrokes between 22:35 and 23:15.

operational_rules: Cyber-Physical Forensics Standard §404: Hardware-address cryptographic packet origin takes precedence over automated software commit timestamps.
Alibi Integrity Rule: Automated scheduled tasks pushing code cannot establish physical human presence.

ground_truth.target_rules_or_method: Remote Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) override payload delivering a fatal 25-unit insulin bolus via concealed Raspberry Pi dongle
ground_truth.target_proof_or_clue: BLE sniffer matched MAC address D4:8A:3F:11:C9:82 on the concealed Pi Zero in Marcus Vance's drawer, and his commit was scheduled via automated cron
ground_truth.explanation: Marcus Vance used a custom Raspberry Pi BLE transmitter concealed in a power bank to broadcast an unauthorized max-bolus command (25.0 units) to Dr. Rostova's insulin pump at 22:42:15 while she was in the cleanroom. His alibi of writing code was proven fraudulent because the git commit was launched by a scheduled cron script.
ground_truth.motive_or_hazard: Dr. Rostova had discovered Marcus faked critical safety audit benchmark scores on the commercial AI model
